neighbours.label: Words for a firm's standing among competitors in a market: market leader, market share, a sector's manufacturers or major players (also German Hersteller, Russian производитель)
fire: Samsung remains the market leader in smartphones this year.
Apple lost market share to cheaper rivals last quarter.
Our firm is a global market leader in industrial pumps.
The merger would give the airline a 40% market share.
Lenders check your file with all three credit bureaus before approving a loan.
Der Test vergleicht Drucker verschiedener Hersteller aus Asien.
Most car manufacturers now sell an electric model.
Only three major manufacturers of jet engines remain worldwide.
quiet: Samsung remains a popular employer in Korea this year.
Apple lost several engineers to cheaper cities last quarter.
Our firm has a new team leader in the pump department.
The merger would give the airline a 40% discount on fuel.
Lenders check your income and your rent before approving a loan.
Der Test vergleicht Drucker verschiedener Farben aus Asien.
Most car drivers now wear a seat belt.
Only three old pilots of jet planes remain in the club.

short: standing among competitors in a market
notes: Card: ' leader' x3, ' manufacturers' x3, 'steller' x2, ' share', 'aus' of credit bureaus, 'ителя'. Probe: market share 1.05, market leader 0.95, credit bureaus 0.87, Hersteller 0.67, manufacturers 0.30, suppliers 0.19; team leader 0.01, share the bill 0.01, fish market 0.01, workers 0.01.
